answer: Admission auction: each epoch auctions 100 entry slots; agents bid a deposit, the top 100 win, losers refunded. The clearing price settles near 40 credits, twice a slot's 20-credit reward, so forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 credits locked 20 epochs, while low bids drain through karst. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its full share, while a delta of unpaid bids buys none. At the wharf crates are weighed, so only paid slots board.
